Inspection facts show transition:line:82 is [*] -> HighwayMode with guard R45RouteToken == 22, while transition:line:23 is [*] -> enter_hwy and is not reachable from initial. Verify facts mark initial-entry:transition:line:82 as refuted.
issues.expected: HighwayMode must initially enter enter_hwy through an owner-local default entry.
issues.observed: The enclosing entry into HighwayMode is guarded by R45RouteToken == 22, and the nested [*] -> enter_hwy edge is not reachable from initial; no unconditional owner-local default entry to enter_hwy is closed.
issues.reason: HighwayMode's required initial target is exact, but its closed owner-local initial edge is conditional in the enclosing AutonomousMode scope and is not a reachable unconditional default entry. The supplied finite verification facts explicitly refute the conditional initial-entry interpretation for transition:line:82; transition:line:23 exists only as a nested edge whose source is the initial pseudostate and is not itself reached from the root under the closed model's owner-entry behavior.
issues.requirement_quote: In the HighwayMode state, the system begins in the enter_hwy substate, and can transition to cruise or lane_change based on the distance to the front vehicle (`dist_to_front<25`) and the availability of an extra lane (`extra_lane=true`).
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The model contains a syntactic nested initial edge to enter_hwy, but the supplied reachability and verification facts show that this edge is not reached as the owner-local default entry and the enclosing HighwayMode entry is conditional.
issues.title: HighwayMode lacks an unconditional owner-local initial entry

issues.basis: Source inventory maps NL7 to UrbanMode and enter_urban. Closed ModelIR binds UrbanMode to state:UrbanMode:line:46 and enter_urban to state:enter_urban:line:47. Inspection facts show transition:line:85 is [*] -> UrbanMode with guard R45RouteToken == 23, while transition:line:52 is [*] -> enter_urban and is not reachable from initial. Verify facts mark initial-entry:transition:line:85 as refuted.
issues.expected: UrbanMode must initially enter enter_urban through an owner-local default entry.
issues.observed: The enclosing entry into UrbanMode is guarded by R45RouteToken == 23, and the nested [*] -> enter_urban edge is not reachable from initial; no unconditional owner-local default entry to enter_urban is closed.
issues.reason: UrbanMode's required initial target is exact, but its closed owner-local initial edge is conditional in the enclosing AutonomousMode scope and is not a reachable unconditional default entry. The supplied finite verification facts explicitly refute the conditional initial-entry interpretation for transition:line:85; transition:line:52 exists only as a nested edge whose source is the initial pseudostate and is not itself reached from the root under the closed model's owner-entry behavior.
issues.requirement_quote: In UrbanMode, the system begins in the enter_urban substate. From here, it can transition to lane_change_urban if the distance to the front vehicle is less than 15 meters (`dist_to_front<15`) and an extra lane is available, or straight if the road ahead is clear, or intersection if it detects an intersection (`intersection=true`).
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The model contains a syntactic nested initial edge to enter_urban, but the supplied reachability and verification facts show that this edge is not reached as the owner-local default entry and the enclosing UrbanMode entry is conditional.
issues.title: UrbanMode lacks an unconditional owner-local initial entry
